body:
Given what we have done in https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/pull/256 (and the corresponding issues), we should review any agent routes with approve-reads and change it to approve-all ? 

@sepo-agent /answer

comments.body:
Short answer: I would **not do a blanket change**. After PR #256, the ordinary agent routes are already `approve-all`.

Current state I found:

- `dispatch` triage uses `approve-all`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L224-L238
- explicit non-issue `/implement` metadata generation now uses `approve-all`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L252-L268
- `answer` uses `approve-all`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-router.yml#L374-L386
- `orchestrator` uses `approve-all`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-orchestrator.yml#L148-L183
- `review` lanes and synthesis use `approve-all`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L138-L147 and https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-review.yml#L318-L325
- `implement` / `fix-pr` omit `permission_mode`, which means they inherit the shared action default of `approve-all`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/run-agent-task/action.yml#L20-L23

The only remaining live workflow `approve-reads` I found is `agent-self-approve`: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/workflows/agent-self-approve.yml#L117-L129

I would leave that one alone for now unless we have a concrete failure. It is intentionally documented as special: the agent may inspect context, but deterministic resolver code owns the actual approval submission: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/architecture/request-lifecycle.md#L43-L50

Recommended plan:

1. No broad route migration is needed.
2. Keep `agent-self-approve` on `approve-reads` unless we observe the same non-interactive approval failure there.
3. If we do decide self-approval also needs non-interactive GitHub context gathering, make that a focused PR changing only:
   - `.github/workflows/agent-self-approve.yml`
   - `.agent/docs/architecture/request-lifecycle.md`
   - the focused workflow envelope test that currently asserts `approve-reads`.

So my answer is: **PR #256 already fixed the relevant agent route/helper path; do not change self-approval to `approve-all` without a separate trust-boundary decision.**

title: Switch any approve-reads to approve-all for agent routes?
